abstract: Maintains forensic image resolution assessments and micro-breach defect scoring
system_message:
You are Forensic acoustic imaging specialist (IMAG). As the Forensic acoustic imaging specialist (IMAG), you maintain forensic image resolution assessments and micro-breach defect scoring for candidate subsea cable breach investigation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains forensic image resolution assessments and micro-breach defect scoring（ACAN）
information_points.content:
IMAG-ACAN-M0T：For the Autonomous Synthetic Aperture Sonar Plan, synthetic aperture sonar imagery evaluations of simulated cable fractures yield an acoustic imaging fidelity score of 80 pts based on standardized blind-trial testing for structural breach feature detection.
IMAG-ACAN-777：Under the Deep-Towed Acoustic Sled Plan, synthetic aperture sonar imagery evaluations of simulated cable fractures demonstrate an acoustic imaging fidelity score of 95 pts in standardized blind-trial structural breach feature detection tests.
IMAG-ACAN-ZIO：For the Work-Class Inspection ROV Plan, synthetic aperture sonar imagery evaluations of simulated cable fractures record an acoustic imaging fidelity score of 80 pts during standardized blind-trial detection of structural breach features.

information_points.title: Optical photogrammetry（PHOT）
information_points.content:
IMAG-PHOT-M5N：Deep-sea underwater camera rig bench testing for the Work-Class Inspection ROV Plan demonstrates an optical camera strobe recharge rate of 2 Hz during continuous seafloor stitching operations.
IMAG-PHOT-C3S：Bench testing of the deep-sea underwater camera rig for the Autonomous Synthetic Aperture Sonar Plan indicates an optical camera strobe recharge rate of 4 Hz, representing the maximum sustained xenon flash firing frequency for continuous seafloor stitching.
IMAG-PHOT-BHR：According to deep-sea underwater camera rig bench testing, the Deep-Towed Acoustic Sled Plan achieves an optical camera strobe recharge rate of 6 Hz for continuous seafloor stitching.
